lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately 5 horizontal rows of high-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in semi-regular vertical columns posterior to the gill slits and pectoral fin base.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of blobs and longitudinal ridges, forming a grid-like pattern of anchor nodes across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct linear ridges running horizontally across the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp luminosity gradient with highlight on the dorsal edge and shadow on the ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: A low-density distribution of approximately 6-8 high-luminance blobs is visible on the lateral surface of the first dorsal fin silhouette.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: The trailing edge of the apex of the first dorsal fin exhibits a jagged notch or irregularity. A high-luminance patch is visible on the distal tip of the pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Multiple small, elongated silhouettes consistent with commensal organisms are visible along the ventral surface and pectoral fin. A single high-contrast yellow pixel cluster is located near the dorsal-anterior region of the head.
